stories.story: As Refund-Runway Rae, I want to enter my term start/end dates and expected refund disbursement date(s) through a guided setup flow, so that the app knows my financial timeline before it can model my spending.
acceptanceCriteria: User can select term start/end date via date picker or preset academic calendar templates
User can input one or more expected disbursement dates within the term
System validates disbursement dates fall within term boundaries and flags invalid entries inline
Setup completable with max 2 required screens for core fields
If user abandons setup partway, progress saved and resumable
No unhandled-error state for empty, malformed, or past-dated inputs

stories.story: As Refund-Runway Rae, I want to enter the dollar amount of my expected refund, so that the app can calculate how much money I have to work with for the term.
acceptanceCriteria: User can input numeric refund amount with currency formatting and inline validation
Field supports 'not sure yet / estimate' path so users without exact figure aren't blocked
Entered amount persisted and editable later
Confirmation screen summarizes term dates + refund amount + next disbursement date

stories.story: As Refund-Runway Rae, I want the app to tell me the next disbursement date and days remaining until it arrives, so that I know when to expect more money without checking my school portal.
acceptanceCriteria: App displays next disbursement date and countdown on summary/home view
Countdown auto-updates daily
If disbursement date passed without confirmation, app prompts user rather than silently erroring
Handles term-ending-with-no-further-disbursement gracefully

stories.story: As Refund-Runway Rae, I want my lump-sum refund automatically divided into a rolling weekly safe-to-spend amount for the rest of the term, so that I don't blow through my money in the first few weeks.
acceptanceCriteria: On setup completion, system calculates initial weekly safe-to-spend = remaining refund / remaining weeks
Calculation accounts for partial weeks without negative/divide-by-zero errors
Weekly figure recalculated at start of each new week
If term data incomplete, engine falls back to clearly labeled estimate
Unit tests cover zero-days-remaining, single-week term, multi-disbursement scenarios

stories.story: As Refund-Runway Rae, I want the app to adjust my future weekly safe-to-spend amounts based on what I've actually spent, so that overspending one week doesn't wreck my budget without warning, and underspending gives me more room later.
acceptanceCriteria: System ingests actual spend and recalculates remaining weekly pacing after each entry or at minimum daily
If cumulative overspend drives future weekly amounts below defined minimum, user gets proactive notice not silent negative number
Recalculation covered by automated tests across 5 spend scenarios (on-pace, overspend, underspend, no spend, spend spike near term end)
Self-correction never results in unhandled exception, even when spend exceeds total refund

stories.story: As Refund-Runway Rae, I want to log or import my spending easily, so that the runway engine has the data it needs to self-correct without feeling like extra homework.
acceptanceCriteria: User can manually add spend entry (amount + optional category) in 3 taps or fewer
If bank/card linking available, imported transactions map to spend entries without manual re-entry
Duplicate/ambiguous entries flagged for review not silently double-counted
Empty/zero-spend weeks handled without error, carry forward full balance

stories.story: As Refund-Runway Rae, I want to see my current safe-to-spend number the instant I open the app, so that I can make a spending decision without digging through menus.
acceptanceCriteria: Single runway number visible on home/landing screen with zero required taps after open
Number reachable in at most 2 taps from any other screen
Screen renders within acceptable load threshold with graceful loading state, not blank screen
If data missing/setup incomplete, surface shows clear CTA instead of error/null
No more than one primary number and minimal secondary text

stories.story: As Refund-Runway Rae, I want a home-screen widget or lock-screen glance option showing my safe-to-spend number, so that I can check it without even opening the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Widget displays current number, updates at least daily or on recalculation
Widget setup optional, doesn't block core app usage if declined
If offline, widget shows last-known value with visible 'as of [date]' indicator
Tapping widget deep-links directly into app's one-number home surface

stories.story: As Refund-Runway Rae, I want a brief, low-effort visual cue (like a color or trend arrow) alongside my number, so that I can tell at a glance whether I'm on track without reading extra text.
acceptanceCriteria: Visual indicator derived directly from runway engine's pacing status
Indicator updates automatically when number recalculates
Indicator has accessible text-equivalent (screen-reader label), not color-only
No additional tap required to see indicator

stories.story: As Refund-Runway Rae, I want the entire setup process (term dates, refund amount, first look at my number) to complete without errors or dead ends, so that I actually finish onboarding instead of abandoning the app.
acceptanceCriteria: End-to-end setup flow tested for zero unhandled-error states across all input edge cases
Setup completion instrumented/tracked against >=80% launch target
Users exiting mid-setup can resume from last completed step
First-run experience surfaces one-number result within same session, reachable in <=2 taps

sources.description: Upstream MVP scope and persona definition ('Refund-Runway Rae') from mvp-planning-agent, including three MVP features and launch criteria
Standard user story / INVEST heuristics applied to size stories for single-sprint delivery

gaps: No direct user research validating specific onboarding fields, terminology, or willingness to enter exact refund amounts vs estimates.
Unspecified whether bank/card linking is in MVP scope or manual-entry-only for spend tracking — affects US-06 sizing.
No confirmed design system or home-screen/widget platform constraints (iOS/Android parity) affecting US-08/US-09 complexity.
No defined error-state taxonomy or QA test matrix for 'zero unhandled-error states' criterion.
No stated multi-disbursement handling detail beyond 'irregular part-time wages' mentioned in persona but not scoped as distinct MVP feature.
nextSteps: Confirm with mvp-planning-agent whether bank/transaction linking is in MVP scope to finalize spend-logging story sizing.
Validate onboarding field requirements with target-persona user research before sprint commitment.
Define shared error-state taxonomy with QA/engineering to operationalize 'zero unhandled-error states' criterion.
Hand sequenced stories to success-metrics-agent to attach instrumentation/success metrics per story.
Clarify home-screen widget/lock-screen platform scope before finalizing US-08 complexity.
